sloka: अभिषेकम् करिष्यामि तासु नित्यम् यतव्रता ।सह त्वया विशाल अक्ष रम्स्ये परम नन्दिनी ॥२-२७-१८॥
transliteration: abhiṣekam kariṣyāmi tāsu nityam yatavratā ।saha tvayā viśāla akṣa ramsye parama nandinī ॥2-27-18॥

translations.english: Observing such vows and bathing daily in the lotus lakes, I shall be very much happy to sport with you, O largeeyed one
